p5.s: The new software allows employees to work more ------- from home.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ work (more + trạng từ) → efficiently.

p5.s: By the time the director arrives, the staff ------- the conference room.
p5.why: By the time + hiện tại đơn (arrives) chỉ tương lai; việc xong trước mốc đó → tương lai hoàn thành will have prepared.

p5.s: The museum will be closed ------- December 24 and January 2.
p5.why: between … and … = trong khoảng giữa hai mốc; from đi với to.

p5.s: Customers ------- orders exceed $100 will receive a free gift.
p5.why: Sau chỗ trống là danh từ orders (đơn hàng của khách) → đại từ quan hệ sở hữu whose.

p5.s: The company plans to ------- its customer service department next year.
p5.why: expand = mở rộng (bộ phận, quy mô).

p5.s: Ms. Romero gave a very ------- presentation on the company's growth plans.
p5.why: Sau very, trước danh từ presentation cần tính từ → informative.

p5.s: ------- the restaurant was fully booked, the manager found a table for us.
p5.why: Hai vế trái ngược (nhà hàng kín chỗ nhưng vẫn có bàn), sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề → Although; Despite cần danh từ.

p5.s: ------- employee must complete the safety training before using the machines.
p5.why: employee số ít, không có mạo từ → Every; All / Many / Most cần danh từ số nhiều.

p5.s: The package ------- to the wrong address last Friday.
p5.why: Gói hàng được giao (bị động) + last Friday (quá khứ) → was delivered.

p5.s: The ------- of the new factory will create more than 200 jobs.
p5.why: Sau The, trước of cần danh từ → construction.

p5.s: Passengers are reminded to keep their ------- with them at all times.
p5.why: belongings = đồ dùng cá nhân, hành lý mang theo.

p5.s: Ms. Torres has been working at the company ------- 2019.
p5.why: Hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn + mốc thời gian (2019) → since; for đi với khoảng thời gian.

p5.s: The more customers we attract, ------- our profits will be.
p5.why: Cấu trúc The more …, the + so sánh hơn … (càng … càng …) → the higher.

p5.s: Ms. Kim suggested that the meeting ------- until next week.
p5.why: suggest that + chủ ngữ + động từ nguyên mẫu; cuộc họp bị hoãn (bị động) → be postponed.

p5.s: The managers will review the proposals ------- before making a final decision.
p5.why: Đại từ phản thân nhấn mạnh: chính các quản lý tự xem → themselves.

p5.s: All visitors must show ------- identification at the front desk.
p5.why: Trước danh từ identification cần tính từ → valid (hợp lệ).

p5.s: Employees who wish to take time off must ------- a request at least two weeks in advance.
p5.why: submit a request = nộp đơn đề nghị.

p5.s: Applicants may submit their forms ------- online or at the front desk.
p5.why: either … or … = hoặc … hoặc …; both đi với and, neither với nor, not only với but also.

p5.s: The conference room is located ------- the end of the hallway.
p5.why: at the end of + nơi chốn = ở cuối (hành lang).

p5.s: There is still ------- information about the new product on the company's Web site.
p5.why: information là danh từ không đếm được → little; few / many / several đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.

p5.s: Mr. Davis ------- for the company for fifteen years before he retired last spring.
p5.why: Việc kéo dài trước một việc quá khứ khác (retired last spring) → quá khứ hoàn thành had worked.

p5.s: Mr. Okafor was ------- satisfied with the results of the customer survey.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ satisfied cần trạng từ → highly (rất).

p5.s: The museum is closed to the public while the main hall is being -------.
p5.why: renovate = cải tạo, sửa sang; is being + V3 (đang được) → renovated.

p5.s: Please return the signed contract to ------- by the end of the week.
p5.why: Sau giới từ to cần đại từ tân ngữ → us.

p5.s: The new store will open ------- the renovations are complete.
p5.why: as soon as = ngay khi; in order to cần động từ nguyên mẫu, so that / even though sai nghĩa.

p5.s: Our team is looking for a ------- solution to the storage problem.
p5.why: Trước danh từ solution cần tính từ → permanent (lâu dài).

p5.s: Please keep your receipt ------- case you need to return an item.
p5.why: in case = phòng khi.

p5.s: If the shipment arrives on time, we ------- the new products on Monday.
p5.why: Câu điều kiện loại 1 (If + hiện tại đơn) → will display.

p5.s: The hotel's new restaurant has received ------- reviews from food critics.
p5.why: excellent reviews = đánh giá rất tốt; eager / anxious chỉ cảm xúc của người, durable = bền.

p5.s: Not only ------- the hotel renovated its rooms, but it has also added a new pool.
p5.why: Not only đầu câu → đảo trợ động từ; renovated là quá khứ phân từ và vế sau dùng hiện tại hoàn thành (has also added) → has.

gaps.why: Câu chèn nói thêm về máy tự thanh toán vừa giới thiệu (nhận cả tiền mặt lẫn thẻ); "đóng lối vào chính" và "tháo máy tháng sau" mâu thuẫn với nội dung thông báo.
Trước: giới thiệu làn tự thanh toán mới; sau: quầy thu ngân thường vẫn mở → ý đối lập: However.
Sau tính từ sở hữu your cần danh từ → patience (sự kiên nhẫn); patients = bệnh nhân.

p6.title: To: All Staff · From: Karen Liu · Subject: Volunteer day
p6.text: Dear colleagues, Our annual volunteer day will take place on Saturday, April 12. This year, we {1} with the Brookside Food Bank to sort donations and pack meals for local families. Last year's event was a great success. {2}, our volunteers packed more than 2,000 meals in just one day. {3} Lunch and T-shirts will be provided for everyone who takes part. If you would like to {4}, please add your name to the sign-up sheet in the break room by April 5. Thank you for helping our community. Karen Liu, Community Relations

gaps.why: Ngày tình nguyện còn ở phía trước (will take place on April 12) → will partner.
Câu sau đưa số liệu chứng minh "rất thành công" → In fact (thật vậy).

o: The food bank is closed on weekends.
The food bank was founded by a local family.
Meals must be ordered a week in advance.
gaps.why: Câu chèn khuyến khích mọi người tham gia, nối với câu sau về quyền lợi (bữa trưa, áo); "đóng cửa cuối tuần" mâu thuẫn với ngày thứ Bảy.
Sau would like to cần động từ nguyên mẫu → participate.

p6.title: Local Bakery Expands
p6.text: Golden Crust Bakery, a family business on Mill Street, will open a second location next month. The new shop will be located in the Riverside Shopping Center and will have seating for forty customers. Owner Teresa Banks started the business twenty years ago in her own kitchen. {1}, it has grown into a company with forty employees that supplies bread to more than thirty local restaurants. "Our customers have been asking us to open closer to the river for years," Banks said. {2} To celebrate the opening, the bakery will give a free loaf of bread to the first hundred {3}. The new shop will be open daily from 7:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M., and it will also offer a {4} selection of sandwiches at lunchtime.

gaps.why: Câu sau dùng hiện tại hoàn thành (has grown), kể sự phát triển từ lúc mở đến nay → Since then.

o: Work on the new shop is nearly complete.
Banks plans to close the Mill Street shop next month.
Several restaurants on Mill Street are also expanding.
Many customers prefer to bake bread in their own kitchens.
gaps.a: Work on the new shop is nearly complete.
gaps.why: Câu chèn nói cửa hàng mới sắp xong, nối sang câu sau về lễ khai trương; đóng cửa hàng Mill Street mâu thuẫn với "a second location".
Sau the first hundred cần danh từ chỉ người → visitors.
Trước danh từ selection cần tính từ → wide (đa dạng).

p6.title: Harlan Insurance · Claims Department
p6.text: Dear Mr. Adebayo, Thank you for contacting Harlan Insurance about your recent claim. We have received the photographs of the damage to your car, and our team {1} them carefully. Based on this review, we have approved your claim for $1,250. {2} The payment will be sent to your bank account within five business days. {3} you have any questions, please call our customer service line at 555-0193. Please have your claim number {4} when you call. Sincerely, Patricia Gomez, Claims Department

gaps.why: Câu sau nói đã duyệt hồ sơ dựa trên việc xem xét này → việc xem ảnh đã xong: has reviewed.

o: This amount covers the full cost of the repairs.
Photographs must be taken in good light.
Your bank account was opened five years ago.
Our customer service line is closed today.
gaps.a: This amount covers the full cost of the repairs.
gaps.why: "This amount" chỉ khoản $1,250 vừa nêu; "tổng đài đóng cửa" mâu thuẫn với lời mời gọi điện ở sau.
Nếu có thắc mắc thì gọi → If; Unless / Although sai nghĩa, Whether cần or.
have + tân ngữ + tính từ (have your claim number ready = chuẩn bị sẵn mã hồ sơ) → ready.

docs.title: Arden Library Gets a Makeover
docs.text: The Arden Public Library will reopen on May 2 after a six-month renovation. The building now has a larger children's area, twenty new computers, and a quiet study room on the second floor. Head librarian Sofia Mendes said the changes reflect how people use the library today. "Many visitors come here to work or study, not just to borrow books," she explained. The renovation cost $2.4 million and was paid for by a gift from a local family and by the city. To celebrate, the library will hold a free concert on its front lawn on the opening day.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
w: The history of a local family
qs.ev: The Arden Public Library will reopen on May 2 after a six-month renovation.
qs.why: Bài đưa tin thư viện mở lại sau sửa chữa.

qs.q: In the article, the word "reflect" is closest in meaning to

qs.why: reflect = phản ánh, cho thấy (show).

qs.q: What will happen on May 2?
qs.a: A free concert will be held.
qs.ev: the library will hold a free concert on its front lawn on the opening day
qs.why: Ngày mở lại (2/5) có buổi hoà nhạc miễn phí trên bãi cỏ.

docs.title: Web page · Greenline Bike Share
docs.text: Greenline Bike Share has more than 500 bicycles at 60 stations across the city. To start, download the Greenline app and create an account. A single ride costs $2 for the first 30 minutes and $1 for every additional 15 minutes. Monthly passes are available for $25 and include unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes. Helmets are not provided, so riders are encouraged to bring their own. Bikes can be returned to any Greenline station.

docs.title: Riverton Market Turns 100
docs.text: RIVERTON — The Riverton Farmers' Market will celebrate its 100th anniversary this Saturday. [1] The market began in 1926 with just six farmers selling vegetables from their wagons. [2] Today, more than eighty vendors sell fruit, cheese, flowers, and baked goods every weekend from April to November. [3] Market manager Paul Okonkwo said the market has survived because it has adapted to changing tastes. "Twenty years ago, nobody here sold organic food. Now it's what most shoppers ask for," he said. [4] Saturday's celebration will include live music, cooking demonstrations, and a display of old photographs of the market.

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
qs.ev: The Riverton Farmers' Market will celebrate its 100th anniversary this Saturday.
qs.why: Chợ nông sản mừng 100 năm.

qs.q: According to Mr. Okonkwo, why has the market been successful?
qs.a: It has changed with customer demand.
qs.ev: the market has survived because it has adapted to changing tastes
qs.why: Chợ tồn tại nhờ thay đổi theo khẩu vị người mua (vd. thực phẩm hữu cơ).

qs.q: In the article, the word "adapted" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: it has adapted to changing tastes
qs.why: adapt to = thích nghi, điều chỉnh theo (adjusted).

qs.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Some of their families still have stands at the market today."
qs.why: "their families" chỉ sáu người nông dân đầu tiên năm 1926 → câu chèn đứng ngay sau câu đó (vị trí [2]).

qs.ev: Keynote: The Future of Online Shopping, Dr. Kenji Mori
qs.why: Bài phát biểu chính do Dr. Kenji Mori trình bày.

qs.q: How much did Ms. Holloway most likely pay to register?
qs.ev: Date submitted: June 2
qs.why: Cô đăng ký ngày 2/6 (phiếu), sau 31/5 nên giá $150 (chương trình).

qs.q: Why was the e-mail sent?
qs.a: To report a change in the program
qs.ev: Her workshop will be replaced by a session on store design
qs.why: Báo thay đổi chương trình: workshop của Carla Diaz được thay.

qs.q: Which session will Ms. Holloway most likely attend at 11:00 A.M.?
qs.ev: at the same time and in the same room
qs.why: Cô chọn workshop của Carla Diaz lúc 11:00 (phiếu, chương trình); e-mail nói buổi này thay bằng buổi về thiết kế cửa hàng cùng giờ, cùng phòng.

qs.q: What should Ms. Holloway bring to the conference?
qs.ev: Please bring a photo ID to collect your name badge
qs.why: Mang giấy tờ có ảnh để nhận thẻ tên.

docs.title: Advertisement · Homestyle Furniture · Spring Sale
docs.text:
Our spring sale runs from March 1 to March 15!
• 20% off all sofas and armchairs
• 15% off dining tables
• Free assembly on all beds
Delivery is free for orders over $500 within 30 miles of our store. Orders under $500 have a delivery fee of $40.

docs.title: Order confirmation · Homestyle Furniture · Order #58213
docs.text:
Customer: Victor Alvarez
Order date: March 10
Item: Linden dining table (oak), regular price $620, sale price $527
Delivery address: 88 Birch Road, Fairview (12 miles from store)
Delivery date: March 18, between 9:00 A.M. and 12:00 P.M.
Delivery fee: $0

docs.title: E-mail · To: Homestyle Furniture Customer Service · From: Victor Alvarez · Date: March 19 · Subject: Order #58213
docs.text:
Hello,
My dining table was delivered yesterday as scheduled, and the delivery team was very polite. However, when I unpacked it, I noticed a deep scratch on the top of the table. I have attached two photos. I would prefer to exchange the table for a new one rather than receive a refund, as it is the exact size I need for my dining room. Please let me know when a replacement can be delivered.
Sincerely,
Victor Alvarez

qs.q: What is NOT offered during the spring sale?
qs.why: Quảng cáo giảm giá sofa / ghế bành và bàn ăn, giường chỉ được lắp miễn phí; không giảm giá giường.

qs.q: Why was Mr. Alvarez not charged for delivery?
qs.a: His order was over a certain amount.
w: He ordered on the first day of the sale.
He picked up the table himself.
qs.ev: Delivery is free for orders over $500 within 30 miles of our store.
qs.why: Giá sau giảm $527 > $500 và nhà cách 12 dặm (< 30) theo phiếu xác nhận → được miễn phí giao như quảng cáo.

qs.q: In the e-mail, the word "exact" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: it is the exact size I need for my dining room
qs.why: the exact size = đúng kích thước (precise).

qs.q: What problem does Mr. Alvarez report?
qs.ev: I noticed a deep scratch on the top of the table
qs.why: Mặt bàn bị xước sâu.

qs.q: What does Mr. Alvarez request?
w: A discount on his next order
qs.ev: I would prefer to exchange the table for a new one rather than receive a refund
qs.why: Anh muốn đổi bàn mới, không muốn hoàn tiền.
